title: Unified Concept Editing in Diffusion Models

bias_targets.methodology: Synthesizing 250 images per profession using the WinoBias dataset and utilizing CLIP classifications to calculate the percentage deviation from an equal (50-50) gender ratio.

Generating images of various professions and performing a qualitative visual analysis to evaluate representation across major U.S. OMB racial categories (White, Black, American Indian, Native American, and Asian), avoiding error-prone quantitative classification.
